model: Japanese Note type (Sentence card by Default)

fields.name: Expression
fields.description: Term expressed (without inflections ! ie conjugation of verbs) using maximal kanji (learned the hard way). If kanji expression is not available, kana is used. This is the best field to put first, for handling search and duplicates.

fields.name: Kanji Notes
fields.description: Empty by default. This field will contain any info about the kanji(s) of the expression you deem necessary: for example radicals, mnemonics, meaning of the kanji, jukugo, readings etc, for kanji n°1 to 4

fields.name: Source
fields.description: URL, show name, book name, etc

fields.name: Translation
fields.description: maybe also include a literal english translation

fields.name: context
fields.description: The whole paragrah/diologue. Typically in books, added manually

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: everthing else is here, grammar, other words defintions

fields.name: furigana
fields.description: I try to use the plain formatting for furigana as much as possible since it is seems more intuitive for me

fields.name: reading
fields.description: Kana reading for the term, or empty for terms where the expression is the reading. This field should not contain any kanji.

fields.name: cloze-body
fields.description: Original inflected term as it appeared before being reduced to dictionary form by Yomitan.

fields.name: Extended definition
fields.description: Here we put the full Yomitan defintionin japanese
